name: LinkLane
long_description: LinkLane helps businesses move freight with a click. Anyone can get a quote and book instantly, while our AI agents find the carrier, negotiate the rate, and manage every load from pickup to delivery. Trucking is a nearly $1 trillion market still run by call centers of brokers working the phones. We're bringing the Amazon experience to freight, making shipping cheaper and easier for every business.
one_liner: AI-powered freight brokerage. Quote, book, and track loads in seconds.
